This listing includes two vintage vacuum tubes, one branded GE Electronic Tube and the other Zenith, both manufactured in the USA. The tubes have glass bodies with metal internal components and multi-pin bases. They show signs of age including discoloration and residue on the glass. Originally housed in a cardboard box labeled for a Tru-Point Pencil Pointer, the items are authentic vacuum tubes used in vintage audio equipment, radios, or electronic devices. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or electronics hobbyists needing original replacement parts.
